content.short: Wirex is a crypto and fiat payments app with a multi currency card, savings accounts and a non-custodial wallet.
content.description: Wirex was founded in 2014 by Pavel Matveev and Dmitry Lazarichev, and launched one of the first contactless cards linked to crypto balances a year later. The app lets people hold, exchange and spend traditional money and digital assets side by side, covering more than 150 currencies with no foreign exchange fees on everyday spending. Cardholders earn Cryptoback rewards in the WXT token at a rate set by their subscription tier, and X-Accounts pay yield on idle balances. Wirex Wallet adds a keyless non-custodial option covering Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana.
